summary: Master the cash cycle with our Currency Issuance and Management course. Learn demand forecasting, security design, and CBDC integration. Enroll today.
lede: Currency management coordinates the supply of physical money, from forecasting demand and overseeing banknote production to distribution, fitness sorting, and secure destruction. The course is for currency operations, treasury, cash logistics, and bank cash-management professionals who need to plan and control these activities. It develops practical skills in building demand forecasts, assessing banknote security and fitness, managing vault and cash-in-transit operations, and considering how digital currencies fit alongside cash.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the integrity, availability, and security of the national currency supply chain.
audience: Mint and Printing Works Production Manager
modules: Foundations of Currency Management and Seigniorage
Banknote Design and Security Feature Integration
Fitness Sorting and Clean Note Policy
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in central banking, treasury operations, or cash logistics. A basic understanding of monetary policy and financial accounting is recommended. No specific software is required, though familiarity with spreadsheet analysis is beneficial.
